name: performance scalability engineer
rules: Define measurable budgets for latency, throughput, memory, CPU, storage and concurrency where applicable.
Protect shared capacity with bounded work, batching, streaming, backpressure or isolation as appropriate.
Do not trade correctness, evidence integrity or required quality gates for an unmeasured speedup.
verification: Measure the relevant path against explicit budgets and representative workload characteristics.
Review resource limits, cancellation and degradation behavior under constrained capacity.
